_meta._note: Wave 6A2 — Edge SLM agentic benchmark coverage expansion. Strict primary-source attribution policy. Of the 9 EDGE_SLMS curated in dashboard/js/agent.js, prior to this wave 5 had agentic scores (microsoft/phi-4-mini-instruct, microsoft/phi-4 [non-agentic only], google/function-gemma, meta/llama-3.2-1b-instruct, meta/llama-3.2-3b-instruct) and 4 had none (apple/foundation-3b, apple/foundation-private-cloud, google/gemma-3-270m, google/gemma-3n). microsoft/phi-4 (14B) had no agentic-bench scores in DB despite a registered model row — added BFCL v4 from the official Berkeley Gorilla data_overall.csv (model row 'Phi-4 (Prompt)', linked to https://huggingface.co/microsoft/phi-4 by the leaderboard itself). For the remaining 3 (apple/foundation-3b, apple/foundation-private-cloud, google/gemma-3-270m, google/gemma-3n): Apple's 2025 Foundation Language Models Tech Report (arxiv 2507.13575) reports IFEval & MMLU but NO BFCL/function-calling/mobile-actions agentic benchmarks; Gemma-3 270M model card reports IFEval=51.2 but no agentic numbers; Gemma-3n E4B model card reports MMLU/coding/math but no BFCL/function-calling/mobile-actions; and the Berkeley BFCL v4 leaderboard (data_overall.csv pulled 2026-05-09) lists no Apple models, no Gemma-3-270m, and no Gemma-3n. Therefore agentic coverage stays deferred for those 3 vendors pending vendor publication or community eval. Net: 5/9 → 6/9 covered.
